name: pipeline-debugger-for-redpanda-connect
description: Step a captured batch through a Redpanda Connect pipeline in the VS Code debugger.

rpcnDebug.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `rpcn-debug` binary that runs debug sessions, for example `<repo>/bin/rpcn-debug`. Machine-scoped, so a workspace can't override it.

allowSideEffects.description: Allow capturing from inputs whose capture has side effects on the system they read from, such as a queue (aws_sqs, amqp_0_9, redis_list, …), a consumer group that is kept, or an input the debugger doesn't know. Each such input gets a warning naming its effect. Without it, the launch fails with SIDE_EFFECTS_NOT_ALLOWED. A rejected input (stdin, http_server, sockets) can't be debugged either way.

cwd.description: The directory that relative paths (pipeline, envFile) resolve against. A relative cwd resolves against the debugger's working directory. When unset, the workspace folder is used.

env.description: Environment variables for the pipeline's ${VAR} interpolations. Values accept ${env:NAME}, which VS Code substitutes from its own environment: reference secrets that way and never put literal secrets in launch.json. Applied last: env overrides envFile, which overrides the debugger's own environment.

envFile.description: A dotenv file of NAME=value environment variables for the pipeline's ${VAR} interpolations: # comments, blank lines, an optional export prefix and quoted values are allowed. A relative path resolves against cwd, and the file must exist. Keep secrets in this file, not in launch.json. Applied after the debugger's own environment and before env, so env overrides it.

inputClasses.description: Overrides the debugger's class of an input component, by component name, e.g. {"aws_sqs": "replay-safe"}: replay-safe (captured freely), side-effecting (needs allowSideEffects) or rejected (never captured). A composite input such as broker takes its worst child's class after the override. Marking an input safer than the debugger thinks it is gets a warning, because the debugger can't prove it.

keepConsumerGroup.description: Keep the consumer groups of the pipeline's inputs for the capture. By default the capture replaces each Kafka-family consumer_group (kafka, kafka_franz, redpanda) and each nats queue with its own debug group rpcn-debug-<user>-<k>, so the production group never rebalances. A kept group joins the production group, whose members rebalance, so the launch then also needs allowSideEffects.

maxMessages.description: The most messages of the captured batch to step through, at most 1024. The rest of the batch is dropped, never acknowledged, and the Debug Console says how many messages were kept.

output.description: Where each delivered batch goes, after output.processors. dry-run (the default) shows it in the Debug Console and writes nothing. real also writes it to the pipeline's output, as in production (its batching and per-output processors included; stdout and stderr outputs are replaced by drop), with a launch warning. none shows it and writes nothing.

pipeline.description: The pipeline YAML file to debug. A relative path resolves against cwd. When unset, the file in the active editor is debugged.
